high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from the Twitter account of Dinesh Karthik (@DineshKarthik), a cricketer. The post was made 5 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The tweet reads: "What we see right now is their success but what we all may not know is the years of hard work and sweat they put in each and every second of those years to reach here." Below the tweet, there is a collage of photographs featuring various Indian athletes holding medals, indicating their success at the Tokyo Olympics.
